revisionDesc.change: Finalized - This should be ready now.

Vote - AcceptText - Ln 8 and 27: agreed. Line 14 --> <:τῆσδε|reg|τῆδε:>. Ln16: it's difficult to see the end of Ἀόλλου; dot the upsilon. Changes in line 17 are both good. Ln28: Gonis presents a good case for reading στοιχεῖ μοι αὕτη, but αὕτη is very difficult to see, as Gonis himself acknowledges. G's reading seems to fit the available space better than that of the ed. pr. Ln32: see Sosin's comments.

Vote - AcceptText - Note: text entered in "Save notes" does not get recorded in the "revision description" in the file. Justification should be (re)entered with submission notes. Gonis' comments were as follows: "In ll. 8 and 27 Ιακίνθου is surely a iotacistic spelling of Ὑακίνθου (the name in this spelling is not attested in LGPN): |reg| added, and breathing removed (just in case). In 27 there is no need to assume that υ was abbreviated. || Added num tag in l. 12. || In l. 14Added accents to διακειμένης and τῆδε (but I would either put τῆ<σ>δε in the text, or give the |reg| form without < >). || Added |reg| in l. 15. || Incorporated correction in l. 16 (Κ̣ολλο̣( ) → Ἀόλλου) proposed in POxy L 3600.11 n., and confirmed on the image (not in BL). || In l. 17 (|ἐπιπεδ[.1]|) → (ἐπιπέδ[(ων)]). Tentatively resolved as ἐπιπέδω(ν)? in ed. pr. (17 n.), it is given as ἐπιπέδων with no question mark in the index (p. 204). For the construction cf. SB XXVI 16755.17. Then, <:ἀνωγαίων|reg|ἀναγαίων:>: the current DDbDP version regularizes to ἀναγκαίων, but this doesn't go back to ed. pr. (or any other published source, as far as I can rell) and is wrong. ἀναγαίων = ἀνωγαίων; this is alluded to in the note and made explicit in the index (p. 197). Cf. also Husson, OIKIA p. 40. || In l. 18 ἀυτῆς → αὐτῆς || In l. 28 στοιχε̣ῖ μοι ἐ̣ν̣ π̣ᾶ̣[σ(?)]ι̣ is singular, and iota is unconvincing. I suggest α̣ὕ̣τ̣η̣; the phrase στοιχεῖ μοι αὕτη ἡ + name of document is common in Oxy. docs of that date, incl. leases (e.g. PBerlZill 7.29). But the lettera αυτ are mostly guessed at (the online image is not very helpful), though eta is likely (certainly no iota here). || In l. 32, I 'updated' the notary's signature, but it's very hard to fit all of Ị[ohannu etelio]th in the break." // Lin14 fine, just enter τῆ<σ>δε without app ; lin16 Ἀόλλου OK (I have trouble seeing upsilon, but OK) ; lin17 (ἐπιπέδ[(ων)]) OK in the light of the index ; lin17 <:ἀνωγαίων|reg|ἀναγαίων:> data entry mistake, good catch ; lin28 α̣ὕ̣τ̣η̣ is nice and well supported (I cannot see it at all on the digital image, but is seems plausible enough, to my eye, not to require outside refereeing; but if next voter prefers such, that is fine with me) ; lin32=> <:~|di emu Ị[ohannu]|~grc-Latn =Diethart–Worp, Notarsunterschriften im byzantinischen Ägypten, p. 82, no. 9.4.1|ed|δ̣ι̣ʼ ἐ̣μ̣ο̣ῦ̣ Ι̣[.5]:> <:~|[etelio]th|~grc-Latn =PN N.
